details: Nmap before 7.992 contains an infinite loop vulnerability in the negotiate_tn3270 function of the NSE tn3270.lua library, whose device-type search loop does not advance when the server sends a protocol-conformant DEVICETYPE IS response without an LU suffix. A TN3270E server on a scanned host, including a non-malicious one that sends such a response, causes a permanent 100% CPU hang of the Nmap process when tn3270-screen.nse runs, which the script-timeout option does not interrupt.
